checks.method: Opened the primary Bucić-He-Lee v1 full text, Theorem 1, and evaluated its k=3 formula with exact fractions.
checks.observation: [Theorem 1](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.26686v1) gives 3(2-1/(16k^3))^n. A simple 68-member rank-four family needs at least 8 support points, since binom(7,4)=35. Already at n=8 its k=3 bound is 3(863/432)^8, approximately 760.918, and increases with n. Direct substitution therefore cannot exclude 68. This does not rule out every further consequence of that paper.
checks.scope: Ground-set theorem as a proposed competing numerical bound

checks.method: Constructed five literal four-sets in a standalone standard-library calculation; tested all ten triples for equal pairwise intersections and all 32 two-colour assignments of the disjointness graph.
checks.observation: The sets {0,1,5,6}, {1,2,7,8}, {2,3,9,10}, {3,4,11,12}, {0,4,13,14} contain no three-sunflower. Their disjointness edges are (0,2),(0,3),(1,3),(1,4),(2,4), with no proper two-colouring. Thus matching number at most two does not justify partitioning into two H27-bounded pools.
checks.scope: H27 versus a hypothetical two-intersecting-part shortcut

checks.method: Expanded the sixteen literal triples of R16 from the definition map, directly checked sunflower-freeness, and enumerated all 16 one-deletions and 120 two-deletions, computing rho by literal intersections.
checks.observation: R16 itself is sunflower-free with rho=7. All 16 size-15 subfamilies have rho=7. Among size-14 subfamilies, 84 have rho=7 and 36 have rho=6; for example deleting 156 and 389 yields rho=6. These witnesses refute the stronger variants size15 implies rho>=8 and size14 implies rho>=7, while agreeing with the manuscript statement.
checks.scope: Boundary examples for Theorem 2 and stronger variants

checks.method: Compared the imported strict theorem with manuscript Sections 5.1 and 6 and LOW15-direct-Jin-A3-addon.md; checked the four relevant cross-products exactly.
checks.observation: At n=68 and graph minimum degree 24, k=5 gives equality 408=408 and is unavailable, whereas k=6 gives 480>476. At minimum degree 25, k=2 fails with 200<204, whereas k=3 gives 275>272. Thus the source does not provide the tempting stronger targets at these thresholds; the manuscript selects valid cases.
checks.scope: Strict Jin thresholds and possible stronger graph targets

checks.method: Read the current assignment, contract, roster and snapshot; inspected the full round02-to-round03 manuscript diff against the previously reviewed text and extracted my own committed history.
checks.observation: The manuscript and canonical snapshot hashes match the assignment. Changes only clarify twelve outer R16 triples and replace link-like anchor notation. The earlier attribution resolution and bounded novelty/import qualifications remain unchanged. No current peer review, pending journal, heavy solver or full replay was consulted.
checks.scope: Frozen theory scope and retained review resolution

findings.disposition: The round02-to-round03 diff changes only anchor notation and the outer-triple wording; the accepted attribution repair remains intact.
findings.statement: The corrected classical attribution remains present and unchanged.

findings.disposition: Retain the cutoff-bounded strongest-located comparison. Testing several plausible alternatives is not an exhaustive search for all possible deductions from the literature.
findings.statement: No exhaustive priority inference follows from the rival checks in this round.

findings.disposition: The explicit five-member SF4 witness in the checks has an odd-cycle disjointness graph and disproves that proposed shortcut. The manuscript correctly uses H27 only for proved intersecting subfamilies.
findings.statement: H27 alone cannot be doubled into a universal upper 54 by assuming every sunflower-free family partitions into two intersecting parts.

findings.disposition: All sixteen one-member deletions have rho=7. Some two-member deletions have rho=6, so extending the same conclusion to every size-14 family would be false. These are explicit example checks, not a proof of the universal size-15 statement or a separate novelty claim.
findings.statement: The asserted size-15 disjointness lower bound is compatible with, and attained by, the canonical imported R16 examples.

revisions.action: Compared the current frozen text with round02 and checked my committed resolution.
revisions.result: The historical attribution repair is unchanged; its resolved status is maintained.

content.summary: The tested alternatives do not remove or contradict the stated contribution. The explicit ground-set theorem does not directly supply upper 67; H27 does not imply a universal two-part decomposition; and stronger Jin specializations fail the strict thresholds available here. Literal R16 subfamilies attain the proposed size-15 rho lower bound. These bounded checks find no manuscript defect but do not certify every new case or exhaustive priority.
